description: Look up an IP's reputation in the SANS Internet Storm Center (DShield) data (keyless): how many attack reports it has across how many target sensors over the observed window, the network/AS it belongs to, and which ISC threat feeds list it. A high report count is a scanning/attacking signal. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Read-only.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 45.83.66.10 or example.com

name: dshield_ip_check
